title: RBI releases draft Master Direction - Reserve Bank of India (Call, Notice and Term Money Markets) Directions, 2026
description: In pursuance of the announcement made in the Statement on Developmental and Regulatory Policies dated April 08, 2026, the Reserve Bank of India has released today the draft Master Direction - Reserve Bank of India (Call, Notice and Term Money Markets) Directions, 2026. Comments on the draft Directions are invited from banks, market participants and other interested stakeholders by July 17, 2026. Feedback on the draft Directions may be forwarded to: The Chief General Manager Reserve Bank of India
